remarks: Discover the charm of waterfront living at River Watch. This beautifully maintained residence offers a private entrance and the convenience of secure garage parking just steps away. Inside, the bright and inviting floor plan is enhanced by hardwood flooring, a spacious kitchen featuring granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances, a dining area, and a comfortable living room with access to a private balcony overlooking the river. The generously sized bedroom includes a walk-in closet and easy access to the full bath, while an in-unit washer and dryer add everyday convenience. Beyond the interior, the true highlight is the setting. Relax on your balcony as the sun paints the evening sky, watch kayakers and rowers pass by on the water, and enjoy the natural beauty of the shoreline and local wildlife. Residents enjoy direct access to the Norwalk River Harbor Loop Trail, kayak and paddleboard storage, and nearby marina access for boating enthusiasts. Ideally located just minutes from Calf Pasture Beach, SoNo's restaurants, shopping, entertainment, I-95, and Metro-North, this home offers the perfect blend of tranquility and accessibility. Experience waterfront living at its finest. hIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS SUBMITTED BY MONDAY, JUNE 8, AT 3 PM
